snippet.name: FIPS-140-3-Crypto-Profiles
snippet.description: FIPS 140-3 compliant IKE and IPSec crypto profiles for VPN configurations. Includes max, recommended, and compat tiers for different security requirements.

ike_crypto_profiles.name: fips-ike-crypto-max
ike_crypto_profiles.description: Maximum security - AES-256-GCM, SHA-512, ECDH P-384

ike_crypto_profiles.name: fips-ike-crypto-recommended
ike_crypto_profiles.description: Recommended for production - Balanced security and compatibility

ike_crypto_profiles.name: fips-ike-crypto-compat
ike_crypto_profiles.description: Maximum compatibility - For legacy device interoperability

ipsec_crypto_profiles.name: fips-ipsec-crypto-max
ipsec_crypto_profiles.description: Maximum security - AES-256-GCM, SHA-512, PFS Group 20

ipsec_crypto_profiles.name: fips-ipsec-crypto-recommended
ipsec_crypto_profiles.description: Recommended for production - GCM modes with strong PFS

ipsec_crypto_profiles.name: fips-ipsec-crypto-compat
ipsec_crypto_profiles.description: Maximum compatibility - CBC and GCM modes
